parsed.why: State-directed targeting: LGBTIQ police register, app-lure entrapment, extortion, raids with forced HIV testing, officer sexual abuse; no GI protection, no working document route, 'entirely negative' society. No trans-specific criminal statute, but police practice is the operative exposure.

Gender-identity hate-crime law, hate-speech ban and police guidelines on detainee address are real traveller-facing positives, but enforcement is documented as weak, attacks unpunished, and society strongly heteronormative; worst violence dated 2014.

No trans-specific offence and no state targeting, but 2024 report documents torture, sexual violence and extortion against LGBT people with slow/absent state response, ambiguous hate-crime cover, 5/100 acceptance and legislative death threats.

No facilities rule, no anti-trans violence record, marriage open since 2025; hostile official remarks and no gender-identity anti-discrimination ground or marker procedure are resident gaps, not visitor restrictions. Small, thin-scene society.

Same-sex conduct criminalised (3 months–2 years) with documented enforcement, no gender recognition, police refuse to investigate anti-LGBT crimes, official religious hostility, 15% acceptance. Outed trans visitor faces arrest and no recourse.
